creator: rerating-catalysts
snapshot: India's 3rd-largest IT services company; diversified across IT & Business Services, Engineering & R&D, HCLSoftware; AI/GenAI positioning (Advanced AI revenue, large bookings) is the forward story; PE (TTM) 19.5x.

catalysts.name: Q2FY27 revenue beat, profit growth soft
catalysts.body: Revenue ₹35,620 Cr, +3.0% QoQ, +11.5% YoY. EBIT margin 18.2% (+131bps QoQ) but *includes* a stated 84bps restructuring drag on EBIT / 62bps on Net Income margin — i.e. underlying margin improvement is smaller than the headline delta. Net Income ₹5,132 Cr, +2.0% QoQ, +2.2% YoY — PAT growth badly lags revenue growth.
catalysts.impact: Revenue +11.5% YoY vs PAT +2.2% YoY — a 9+ point gap; margin-dilutive quarter despite the revenue beat
catalysts.forwardMarker: If Q3FY27 doesn't show EBIT margin re-expanding back toward the top of the 17.5-18.5% FY27 guided band once the restructuring drag rolls off, treat the margin story as structurally weaker, not transitional.

catalysts.name: Advanced AI / GenAI revenue + large bookings
catalysts.body: Advanced AI revenue reported at $219M; new bookings (Deal TCV) of $3,258M for the quarter; FCF/NI (LTM) at 87%. Genuine AI-theme participation, but the release's own numbers don't yet show this translating into margin or PAT acceleration this quarter.
catalysts.impact: $219M Advanced AI revenue — undisclosed as % of total revenue; optionality, not yet quantifiable EPS impact
catalysts.forwardMarker: Watch whether Advanced AI revenue is broken out explicitly (as a % of total) in Q3FY27 — its absence this quarter is itself a data-quality flag.

signalItems.subject: Q2FY27 results + investor release + ₹12/share interim dividend

noiseItems.subject: Press release — South Africa HQ / AI Centre of Excellence opening
Press release — India Mobile Congress showcase

whatsInThePrice: At 19.5x TTM PE (a premium to TCS's 15.86x), the market is already paying up for HCLTECH's AI/platform narrative. Today's +7.94% move with ₹954 Cr delivery value and ACT-tier conviction looks larger than the quantified results (PAT +2.2% YoY) obviously justify — this reads as the market buying the AI-bookings narrative and the revenue-beat headline over the weaker profit-growth substance, which is a reasonable but not risk-free read.

risks.risk: Restructuring costs recur or extend beyond this quarter, keeping margin below the guided 17.5-18.5% band
risks.mitigant: Management explicitly quantified the drag (84bps/62bps) this quarter — transparency is a positive sign, but recurrence needs watching

risks.risk: Market may be over-crediting the AI-bookings number ($3,258M TCV, $219M Advanced AI revenue) without a clear read on margin/EPS conversion timeline
FY27 guidance (2.5-4.0% CC revenue growth) is itself modest — limited headroom if execution slips

verdict: Mixed quarter: a genuine revenue beat (+11.5% YoY) undercut by soft profit growth (PAT +2.2% YoY) and a modest FY27 guide. Today's ACT-tier, heavy-delivery rally (+7.94%, ₹954 Cr delivered) looks disproportionate to the quantified EPS numbers in isolation — flagging this as a LINKAGE: MISMATCHED case for the email rather than a clean 'explained' one. The AI-bookings/Advanced-AI-revenue narrative is real but unquantified relative to total revenue, so it cannot by itself justify the move either. Worth a follow-up check at D+2/D+5 on whether the rally holds.
jCurveReason: PAT +2.2% YoY is far below the 30% YoY threshold and even below revenue growth (+11.5% YoY) — a margin-dilutive quarter, not a re-rating inflection, despite the AI-bookings narrative.
